checks.name: A complete reply starts bound to its exact stable question
A completed document temporarily lacking all turns waits for the original binding
A loading shell cannot reuse old full content or accumulate completion evidence
Same-route hydration restores the original binding and complete answer
Virtualizing only the bound user turn never claims the conversation changed
Restoring a virtualized user resumes exact observation
An empty question placeholder is incomplete hydration rather than a confirmed edit
Hydrated text restores the exact question binding
A nonempty changed question still invalidates the old binding
A real later question remains distinct from loading and blocks the old completion
An empty neutral home route during recovery stays pending without rebinding
An interactive new-chat home route is still a different conversation
A different conversation ID is rejected even while its page is blank
A native task with a known conversation route rejects another conversation too
A native known conversation also waits through a neutral root loading shell
The native known conversation resumes its original exact reply
Home-to-conversation assignment accepts only the original stable ID and exact prompt
After assignment another conversation ID cannot inherit the completed binding
A newly assigned route without its original question cannot finish from cached text
The same stable key with different text cannot authorize route assignment
A position-derived key cannot authorize home-to-conversation assignment
Route assignment requires full normalized prompt equality, not similar long-text edges
A socket phrase inside ordinary answer text is not a website error
An unrelated global retry cannot use ordinary answer text as its error context
A shared retry wrapper excludes its ordinary conversation children from error text
A reply retry control does not treat the neighboring normal markdown as an error
A visible historical assistant alert cannot interrupt the current healthy reply
A historical retry card beside its old message body remains inactive
An unlabelled historical section still owns its old retry card
A user-quoted alert cannot become an active website failure during inspection
A real current-turn alert beside its reply body remains recoverable
A current retry beside the response reads its error without reading the response body
A visible official alert reports a recoverable website socket failure
Website inspection exposes the same socket state without a pending task
A connection alert is retained while the bound turn is unavailable
Hidden old socket alerts never become the active website error
A quoted alert inside a code block cannot become a website failure
The official retry error surface is recognized without scanning normal answer content
Removing the website error leaves the original task eligible for exact reinspection
Read-only waiting, recovery and assignment never resend the question
Login cookies and the unsent draft survive every read-only observation
